raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
ServiceNow Senior Developer with 5 years of experience building scalable platform solutions across Custom Applications, ITSM, Integrations, Performance Analytics, Configuration Management Data Base (CMDB), Flow Designer, Predictive Intelligence and Strong engineering focus on automation, performance optimization, and secure design.
Experienced in owning end-to-end feature development, driving automation initiatives, collaborating with architects and business stakeholders, and delivering production-grade solutions in enterprise environments.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
ServiceNow Development: Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Fix Scripts, Scoped Applications, Glide API’s, App Engine Studio, Server-side & Client-side Scripting.
Integrations: Custom REST APIs, Inbound Email Actions, SOAP, Integration Hub, Inbound-Outbound Integrations, Bi-directional, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Cross-Scope Privileges, Application Registry.
Flow Designer: Flows, Sub-flows, Actions, Triggers, Decision tables, playbooks, Spokes, error handling, flow context, Workflow automation.
CMDB: Data model administration, MID Server, Service Mapping, Configure CMDB, Discovery, Life Cycle management, CMDB Reporting, CI Class manager.
Analytics & Intelligence: Performance Analytics (PA), Predictive Intelligence (PI), UI Builder, KPI Signals, Indicators & Breakdowns, Dashboards, Interactive Filters, Advanced Reporting.
Platform Configuration: Service Level Agreements (SLA), Schedules & Schedule Entries, ACLs, Table Design & Dictionary Configuration, Database Views, Form Design, System Data management Jobs, Archive Rules.
Release & Administration: Update Sets, UAT & Production Deployment, Instance Upgrades, Defect Analysis & Root Cause Fixes, Version Upgrades.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
INFOSYS LIMITED (Jan 2025 – Present)
Senior ServiceNow Developer / SME Client: ALLIANZ COMMERCIAL
Configuration Management Database [CMDB]:
Designed and implemented robust CI Class hierarchies, Identification/Reconciliation rules, and data certification schedules to maintain high CMDB health.
Configured ServiceNow Discovery, Orchestration, MID Servers, and Service Mapping to automatically populate and track enterprise IT in real-time.
Created and managed CI classes, relationships, and attributes based on business requirements.
Worked on CI lifecycle management, including creation, updates and retirement of CIs. • Worked with Data Certification and Data Manager to maintain CMDB integrity. • Created CMDB reports using CMDB query builder, unified maps. • Monitored and improved CMDB health KPIs by creating automating remediation workflows. Integrations:
Experience with Web Services, integration protocols, REST APIs, Integration Hub/spokes, SOAP. • Configured Bi-Directional integration between ServiceNow and Internal hosted ADSR application. • Developed synchronization between outbound and inbound REST Integrations with internal and external applications.
Reduced manual ticket creation effort by 90% through the implementation of automated, rule-based inbound email integrations across platform.
Developed custom REST APIs and Scripted REST APIs for seamless communication between SNow & external systems.
Created and maintained MID Server integrations for on-premises systems. • Experience with authentication methos – OAuth 2.0, basic Auth, Mutual auth, Session Tokens, API Keys. • Configured Import Sets and Transform Maps for structured data migration and integration support. Flow Designer:
Monitored and resolved integration issues using system logs and transaction diagnostics. • Designed & developed automated workflows using flow designer to streamline business processes. • Created re-usable custom actions and sub-flows to improve automation efficiency. • Automated Custom application tables workflows using flow designer and integration hub. • Optimized existing flows to improve performance and reduce execution time. • • Configured Decision tables to handle complex logic statements. Custom Application Development: Implemented error handling and logging mechanisms in flow designer.
Developed multiple custom ServiceNow applications, leading enhancements, maintenance, and support activities in collaboration with the solution architect.
Designed and built scoped custom applications which improved business process efficiency by ~55– 75%.
Configured Email Notifications, Events, and Event Registry to support business-driven communication workflows, including automated escalation mechanisms for On-Hold tickets. • Designed and configured complex SLA models including business-day SLAs, scheduled SLAs, user-
defined breach SLAs, and month-end closure SLAs to ensure compliance tracking.
Used GlideSysAttachment API to copy attachment from inbound emails to Records and/or parent ticket to child tickets based on requirements.
Developed Client Scripts, Business Rules, Script Includes, Scheduled Jobs, and Fix Scripts to deliver scalable custom functionalities aligned with ServiceNow best practices. Implemented role-based access control using ACLs to ensure secure data access across applications.
• Designed custom tables, dictionary attributes, relationships, and reference qualifiers to support scalable application architecture.
Managed Update Sets, coordinated UAT and production releases, and performed defect analysis with root cause resolution.
Collaborated with Stakeholders, Architects, Business Analysts in requirement gathering sessions, solution design discussions, effort estimation, and stakeholder demos including management-level presentations.
WIPRO LIMITED (Dec 2021 – Jan 2025) Technical Consultant – ServiceNow Developer
Client: GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)
Performance Analytics (PA): • Led end-to-end Performance Analytics development including KPI configuration, indicators, breakdown
sources, widgets, dashboards, Interactive Filters, and automated data collection jobs, Spotlights.
Worked within the Employee Engagement / NOW Intelligence team, focusing on Performance Analytics, Predictive Intelligence, ITSM and platform reporting solutions, Agile Methodologies.
Engineered a centralized PA Admin Dashboard for real-time reporting health monitoring, reducing manual

developer monitoring effort by 90% across platform. Implemented automated cleanup of unused OOTB reports and dashboards to optimize system performance, with the initial run removing 62k reports.
Familiarity with UI Builder and its configuration including page parameters, data resources, client state parameters, data resources, and event mapping
Configured KPI Signals to detect abnormal variations and trigger proactive alerts for PA reports which allowed Process owners to take necessary action.
Designed dashboards to provide historical trend analysis and real-time data visibility for improved decision-making.
Developed advanced reports including drill-down, multi-dataset, and database view-based reports. • Developed automated and formula-based indicators aligned to business KPIs. • Created and managed a PA Power User community to support business stakeholders and improve reporting adoption.
Executed periodic PA and Predictive Intelligence health scans to ensure system performance and data accuracy.
Predictive Intelligence: • Designed and deployed Predictive Intelligence models using Classification, Similarity, and Clustering
frameworks.
Automated ticket field prediction for Incident, Interaction, and HR Case tables by implementing advanced classification models in workspace; resulted in 75% reduction of reassignments, and 90% faster response/resolution times.
Configured Similarity models to suggest related HR cases, improving agent efficiency and resolution accuracy.
Developed clustering models to analyse service trends and identify data-driven insights for business stakeholders.
CMDB:
Maintained ServiceNow CMDB configuration items (CIs), attributes, and relationships to ensure accurate and up-to-date configuration data.
Monitored CMDB Health and assisted in identifying and resolving completeness, correctness, and compliance issues.
Performed CMDB data cleanup and validation, including identification of duplicate, stale, missing, and inaccurate CI records.
Supported CI certification activities by reviewing assigned CIs and validating configuration data with respective application/infrastructure teams.
Created and reviewed CMDB reports and dashboards to track data quality, health, and certification status.
ITSM & Platform Administration: • Supported Incident, Request, Problem, and Defect management processes. • Managed ACL configurations and resolved user access and role-related issues. • Contributed to multiple ServiceNow version upgrades and post-upgrade remediation activities. • Authored knowledge articles to reduce recurring ticket volumes. • Supported Agile delivery through backlog refinement, story estimation, sprint execution, peer reviews, and
production releases.
Worked within Agile Scrum methodology, participating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups.
